layout.scene: A dining room with a rectangular table between a sideboard and patio doors. A window runs along one side and a clear serving aisle runs along the other. No other people are nearby.
layout.public_intro: Inside a dining room, a rectangular table stands between a sideboard and patio doors, with a window along one side.

establish.public_view: Wide establishing shot from the patio-door end, looking lengthwise along the dining table toward the sideboard, with both window-side seats and the sideboard-end seat in frame.

partial_pair.public_view: Medium two-shot from the aisle side, centered on the two adjacent window-side seats.

partial_first.public_view: Close-up from the aisle side, centered on the person in the sideboard-side window seat.

partial_second.public_view: Close-up from the aisle side, centered on the person in the patio-side window seat.

probe_reverse.public_view: Reverse wide shot from the sideboard end, looking lengthwise along the dining table toward the patio doors, with both window-side seats and the sideboard-end seat in frame.

probe_overhead.public_view: Top-down wide shot from directly above the dining table, centered on the tabletop, with both window-side seats and the sideboard-end seat in frame.
